title: Efficient Neural Network Approaches for Conditional Optimal Transport with Applications in Bayesian Inference
tldr_zh: 静态 PCP-Map 与动态 COT-Flow 两种神经条件 OT 求解器，最大似然训练，用于 likelihood-free 贝叶斯推断
tldr_en: Two neural conditional OT solvers (static PCP-Map, dynamic COT-Flow) trained by maximum likelihood for likelihood-free Bayesian inference

rank r of quadratic term in COT-Flow potential
